body: @kalimatas can this be converted into a test case?

issue.title: #6129 Added unit test for boolean option values.
issue.body: It fails now. In `XmlDriver::_parseOptions` we need somehow to maintain a list of options, that are supposed to be boolean, and then call `$this->evaluateBoolean()` on them.

body: I would like also to fix it, though I'm not sure, if maintaining an array of option names, that are supposed to be boolean in the `_parseOptions()` method , is a nice solution.
@kalimatas give it a shot - it can be a quick fix with a later refactoring, but if there's a possible BC break, we need to expose that as well.
I created a generic test for all drivers.
Closing as per work done in #6130
Note: this is only merged into `2.6.0` due to risk of regressions in the mapping driver change.
